# apptrust_application_version (Data Source)

Returns details of a specific application version (GET /v1/applications/{application_key}/versions).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_key` (String) The application key.
- `version` (String) The version identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Timestamp when the version was created.
- `created_by` (String) The user who created the version.
- `current_stage` (String) Current lifecycle stage.
- `release_status` (String) Release status: pre_release, released, trusted_release.
- `status` (String) Processing status of the version.
- `tag` (String) Tag associated with the version.
